instruction: walk away from fireplace, through the doorway on the left side of the bed, continue straight, turn left through doorway to bathroom and stop.

steps.thought: The fireplace is on my right; I need to walk away from it toward the bed and its left-side doorway. I'll turn left to survey the room first.
A chair blocks the immediate view; the bed is on the left with a doorway beyond it. I'll turn left and step forward to get around the chair toward the doorway on the left side of the bed.
The arched doorway is on the left side of the bed ahead. I'll turn left to align with it, then move forward.
I'm facing the bed; the arched doorway is at the left side of the bed near the headboard. I'll turn left and approach it.
I'm facing the bed headboard; the doorway is on the left side of the bed, so I need to turn left and walk around the bed toward that arched doorway.
I see the arched doorway on the left side of the bed. I'll turn left to face it and move through.
The arched doorway on the left side of the bed is ahead; I'll walk toward it and through it.
I see the arched doorway on the left side of the bed ahead. I'll walk toward it and through it.
I'm beside the bed facing the arched doorway; I need to pass through it and continue straight before looking for a left doorway to the bathroom.
I'm in the hallway past the bed, facing an arched doorway ahead. I'll continue forward through it, then look for the left doorway to the bathroom.
I'm in the hallway past the bed; ahead there's a doorway on the left which should be the bathroom. I'll advance toward it, then turn left.
I'm in a hallway continuing straight. There's a doorway on the left ahead which could be the bathroom; I'll advance toward it and check.
I've continued straight down the hall; now there's an arched doorway on my left with bright light beyond, likely the bathroom. I'll turn left to align with it.
I'm facing a wall too closely; the arched doorway I passed is behind me. I'll turn right to reorient toward the hallway and find the bathroom doorway.
I'm in a hallway with an arched doorway on the left; the instruction says turn left through the doorway to the bathroom. I'll turn left and move toward it.
I'm facing a wall up close; the hallway with the arched doorway was to my right. I'll turn right to re-align with the corridor and then proceed toward the bathroom doorway.
I'm in a hallway with an open wooden doorway on the right, which may be the bathroom. I'll turn right to face it and check.
I'm in a hallway with a mirror arch ahead and doorways around. The instruction says turn left through a doorway to the bathroom, so I'll turn left to scan for it.
I'm in a hallway junction; the instruction says to turn left through a doorway to the bathroom. I see a doorway on the right and an arch ahead, so I'll turn left to look for the bathroom doorway.
I've turned too far left and am now facing a wall. I need to turn right to re-face the hallway with the doorways, then head toward the doorway on the right that leads to the bathroom.

I'm in a hallway with an arched opening ahead and a wooden door to the right. The instruction says to continue straight then turn left through a doorway to the bathroom, so I'll advance toward the arch first and look for a left-side doorway.
I'm in a hallway; the open doorway ahead on the right likely leads to the bathroom per the instruction. I'll advance toward it and check alignment.
I'm close to a wall with a picture; the open wooden door on the right likely leads to the bathroom. I'll turn right toward it and approach.

I'm in a hallway with an open wooden door ahead and another opening to the right. The instruction says to continue straight and turn left through a doorway to the bathroom; the open door ahead looks like the target doorway, so I'll advance toward it and re-observe.

I'm in a hallway facing a wall with an open wooden door slightly to my right, and beyond it a room with a mirror that looks like the bathroom. I'll turn right to align with that doorway and move toward it.
I'm in a hallway facing an open doorway leading to a room with a tall mirror and cabinet, which looks like the bathroom. I'll advance toward it and re-observe before entering.
I'm in a hallway facing a dresser; the instruction says to turn left through a doorway to the bathroom. I should turn left to locate that doorway.
I'm facing a wall; the hallway with the dresser is to my right. I'll turn right to re-enter the hallway and look for the bathroom doorway on the left.
I'm facing a wall; the hallway with the dresser is to my right. I'll turn right to face down the hallway, then proceed to find the bathroom doorway on the left.
I'm in a room with a dresser and arched mirror; the bathroom doorway should be to my left. I'll turn left to scan for it.
I'm in a hallway with an open wooden door on the right, which appears to lead to the bathroom. I'll turn right toward it and move through.
I'm in a hallway facing a closed wooden door with a dresser ahead. The bathroom doorway should be nearby; I'll turn left to scan the wall for an open doorway.
I'm in a bedroom with a rug ahead; the bathroom doorway should be on the left. I'll advance toward the rug and then turn left to locate the doorway.
I'm in a bedroom with dressers and a rug, but no doorway to a bathroom is visible ahead. I'll turn left to scan for the bathroom doorway.
I'm in a bedroom corner near a large dresser; no doorway is visible ahead. I'll turn left to scan for the bathroom doorway.
I'm facing a dresser/wall closely; the bed is behind me. I need to turn left to find the doorway on the left side of the bed.

I've passed the bed area and now see a doorway ahead-left with wood flooring beyond. The instruction says to turn left through a doorway to the bathroom, so I'll rotate left and approach that opening.
I see a hallway with an arched doorway ahead-left leading to a bathroom (tiled room with window). I need to turn left and head through that archway.
I see a bathroom through the arched doorway ahead. I'll advance toward it and stop inside.
The arched doorway ahead opens into a room with a bathtub and window, which appears to be the bathroom. I'll advance through the arch and then stop.
The arched doorway ahead opens into a room with a bathtub, which appears to be the bathroom. I'll advance through the arch and stop inside.
I've turned and am facing an open doorway into a bathroom with a tub visible. I'll step through and stop inside.
I have passed through the doorway into the bathroom with the large tub visible ahead; I am within the bathroom, so I stop here.
